local_context.value: North Charleston spans parts of Berkeley, Charleston and Dorchester counties. 2020 census: 11.8% of residents were 65 or older; 50,563 housing units (9.2% vacant). Airport-station climate normals: about 51 inches of precipitation a year, wettest in mid-summer. Planned community Park Circle dates from 1912.

place_entities.value: Trident Regional Medical Center ("North Charleston's major hospital"); Charleston Southern University; North Charleston Coliseum; H.L. Hunley Museum; Park Circle; Riverfront Park
